Countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe highlight this issue, leaving creators without reliable infrastructure. COREMERCH offers a robust solution for deploying your digital store using Stack 01 or Stack 02, ensuring you have sovereignty over your commerce without reliance on restrictive platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional digital payment landscape is riddled with barriers, particularly in many emerging markets. COREMERCH's infrastructure circumvents these issues by providing a self-hosted solution. By leveraging GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages paired with NOWPayments, you create an online store that operates outside the constraints of conventional payment processors. This architecture not only fosters independence but also grants you full ownership of your data and sales, a critical advantage when platforms may fail or restrict access.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, it's essential to gather the necessary tools and information. For Stack 01, ensure you have a GitHub account for hosting your website and access to Google Apps Script for backend functionality. Familiarize yourself with NOWPayments to facilitate seamless crypto transactions. Additionally, compile your digital products and prepare your marketing materials to ensure a smooth transition from development to live sales. With the Sovereign Blueprint priced at $47, you can access comprehensive documentation to guide you through every step.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your infrastructure ready, the next step is setting up your payment processing and product delivery. Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept a variety of cryptocurrencies, ensuring you select recommended networks like BSC or Solana to minimize transaction costs. Utilize Google Apps Script to automate order confirmations and product delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This streamlined pipeline ensures that once a transaction is confirmed, customers receive their products instantly, enhancing the shopping experience.
Take control of your commerce with sovereign infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With everything in place, you're ready to go live. Test your entire setup on the mainnet to ensure all components work seamlessly together. Once confirmed, launch your store and promote it through your preferred channels. The first transaction is a crucial milestone; monitor it closely to address any potential issues. Successful completion will validate your setup and provide essential insights into optimizing your store for future sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing your digital store, consider strategies for scaling. With your COREMERCH setup, you can easily expand your product offerings and increase marketing efforts. Use the insights gathered from your initial transactions to refine your approach and enhance customer engagement. Explore integrating additional tools or expanding your payment options to cater to a broader audience. The flexibility of your infrastructure means growth is not just possible; it's expected.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can use COREMERCH's Stack 01 with GitHub Pages and NOWPayments. This setup allows you to create a fully operational online store without relying on traditional payment platforms. By following the Sovereign Blueprint, you can deploy your store in 4-6 hours, giving you full control without ongoing fees.
Your data, your products, your profits — own it all.

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent choices for hosting your digital product store. They provide the infrastructure needed to create a reliable and independent online presence.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a diverse audience with various payment preferences, ensuring seamless transactions for your digital products.
How do I ensure my customers receive their products after payment?

By automating your order processing with Google Apps Script and integrating with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, you can ensure that customers receive their products immediately after payment confirmation.
